title: Putting HUMANS first: Efficient LAM Evaluation with Human Preference Alignment
comment: Proceedings of the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
summary: The rapid proliferation of large audio models (LAMs) demands efficient approaches for model comparison, yet comprehensive benchmarks are costly. To fill this gap, we investigate whether minimal subsets can reliably evaluate LAMs while reducing costs and data redundancy. Analyzing 10 subset selection methods with 18 audio models across 40 tasks covering major LAM evaluation dimensions, we show that subsets of just 50 examples (0.3% of data) can achieve over 0.93 Pearson correlation with full benchmark scores. To understand how well these scores align with what practitioners ultimately care about, user satisfaction, we collect 776 human preference ratings from realistic voice assistant conversations, finding that both subsets and full benchmark achieve only 0.85 correlation with human. To better predict preferences, we trained regression models on these selected subsets, achieving 0.98 correlation -- outperforming regression models trained on both random subsets and the full benchmark. This demonstrates that in regression modeling, well-curated subsets outpredict the full benchmark, showing quality over quantity. We open-source these regression-weighted subsets as the HUMANS benchmark, an efficient proxy for LAM evaluation that captures both benchmark performance and user preferences.

AI.tldr: 本文发现仅用0.3%的数据子集（50个样本）即可高效评估大型音频模型，并提出了一个同时衡量基准性能与用户偏好的HUMANS基准。
AI.motivation: 大型音频模型（LAM）快速增多，但全面基准测试成本高昂，亟需低成本、高效率的模型评估方法。
AI.method: 分析了10种子集选择方法，覆盖18个音频模型和40个任务；收集776个真实语音对话的用户偏好评分；训练回归模型预测用户满意度。
AI.result: 50样本的子集与完整基准达到0.93 Pearson相关；回归模型在子集上达到0.98相关，优于完整基准（0.85）。
AI.conclusion: 精心策划的子集比完整基准更能预测用户偏好，体现了质量胜于数量，并开源了HUMANS基准。

title: NorBERTo: A ModernBERT Model Trained for Portuguese with 331 Billion Tokens Corpus
comment: This article has already undergone formal submission, review, acceptance, and publication in the proceedings of PROPOR 2026: Proceedings of the 17th International Conference on Computational Processing of Portuguese, Vol. 1. The published version is available in the ACL Anthology at https://aclanthology.org/2026.propor-1.18/ 11 pages, 9 tables, 2 figures
summary: High-quality corpora are essential for advancing Natural Language Processing (NLP) in Portuguese. Building on previous encoder-only models such as BERTimbau and Albertina PT-BR, we introduce NorBERTo, a modern encoder based on the ModernBERT architecture, featuring long-context support and efficient attention mechanisms. NorBERTo is trained on Aurora-PT, a newly curated Brazilian Portuguese corpus comprising 331 billion GPT-2 tokens collected from diverse web sources and existing multilingual datasets. We systematically benchmark NorBERTo against Strong baselines on semantic similarity, textual entailment and classification tasks using standardized datasets such as ASSIN 2 and PLUE. On PLUE, NorBERTo-large achieves the best results among the encoder models we evaluated, notably reaching 0.9191 F1 on MRPC and 0.7689 accuracy on RTE. On ASSIN 2, NorBERTo-large attains the highest entailment F1 (~0.904) among all encoders considered, although Albertina-900M and BERTimbau-large still hold an advantage. To the best of our knowledge, Aurora-PT is currently the largest openly available monolingual Portuguese corpus, surpassing previous resources. NorBERTo provides a modern, mid-sized encoder designed for realistic deployment scenarios: it is straight-forward to fine-tune, efficient to serve, and well suited as a backbone for retrieval-augmented generation and other downstream Portuguese NLP systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了NorBERTo，一个基于ModernBERT架构的巴西葡萄牙语编码器模型，并构建了目前最大的公开葡萄牙语语料库Aurora-PT（3310亿token），在多项NLU任务上取得了优异性能。
AI.motivation: 葡萄牙语NLP领域缺乏高质量语料库和现代编码器模型，现有模型如BERTimbau和Albertina PT-BR采用较旧的编码器架构，缺乏长上下文支持和高效注意力机制。
AI.method: 基于ModernBERT架构构建NorBERTo，支持长上下文和高效注意力；从网络资源和现有多语数据集中收集并整理了3310亿GPT-2 token的Aurora-PT语料库；在ASSIN 2和PLUE等基准上对模型进行系统评估。
AI.result: NorBERTo-large在PLUE的MRPC上达到0.9191 F1，RTE上达到0.7689准确率；在ASSIN 2上取得最高蕴含关系F1（约0.904），但在部分任务上仍略逊于Albertina-900M和BERTimbau-large。
AI.conclusion: NorBERTo是一个现代化的中型编码器，易于微调、部署高效，适合作为检索增强生成等下游葡萄牙语NLP系统的骨干模型；Aurora-PT成为目前最大的公开葡萄牙语单语语料库。

title: How Frontier LLMs Adapt to Neurodivergence Context: A Measurement Framework for Surface vs. Structural Change in System-Prompted Responses
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Benchmark, code, and data available at https://github.com/ishansgupta/ndbench
summary:
We examine if frontier chat-based large language models (LLMs) adjust their outputs based on neurodivergence (ND) context in system prompts and describe the nature of these adjustments. Specifically, we propose NDBench, a 576-output benchmark involving two frontier models, three system prompt types (baseline, ND-profile assertion, and ND-profile assertion with explicit instructions for adjustments), four canonical ND profiles, and 24 prompts across four categories, one of which involves an adversarial masking strategy.
  Four trends emerge consistently from our findings. First, LLMs show significant adaptation under ND context, where fully instructed conditions yield lengthier and more structured outputs, characterized by higher token counts, more headings, and more granular steps (p < 10^-8, Holm-corrected). Second, such adaptation is largely structural in nature: although list density does not change much, there is a marked rise in the frequency of headings and per-step detail. Third, ND persona assertion alone fails to suppress potentially harmful tendencies, as masking-reinforcement decreases only in explicitly instructed cases (36-44% reduction); the reduction rate barely changes in persona assertion conditions.
  Moreover, reliability analysis of LLM-based harm assessment reveals that only two out of the six dimensions (masking and reinforcement, validation quality) exceed the pre-defined inter-judge agreement criterion (alpha >= 0.67) and thus can be considered primary results.
  NDBench is made publicly available along with its prompts, outputs, code, and other resources, forming a reproducible framework for auditing future LLMs' adaptation to ND awareness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NDBench基准，测试前沿大语言模型是否根据神经多样性情境调整输出。结果发现：模型在充分指令下输出更长、更结构化；调整主要是结构性的；仅靠神经多样性人格描述无法抑制有害倾向；LLM自身有害性评估的可靠性有限。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM研究缺乏对神经多样性（ND）群体的系统性关注，不清楚模型是否会及如何根据ND上下文调整输出，尤其是这种调整是否带来潜在危害。
AI.method: 构建NDBench基准，包含576个输出，涉及2个前沿模型、3种系统提示类型（基线、ND人格描述、ND人格描述+明确调整指令）、4种ND画像、4个类别共24个提示词（含对抗性掩码策略）。
AI.result: （1）充分指令下输出更长、更多标题、更细粒度步骤（p<10^-8）；（2）调整主要是结构性（标题和步骤细节增加，列表密度变化不大）；（3）仅ND人格描述无法抑制有害倾向，仅在明确指令下掩码强化降低36-44%；（4）LLM有害性评估中仅两个维度（掩码与强化、验证质量）达到预定义信度标准。
AI.conclusion: LLM会根据ND情境做出结构性调整，但仅靠ND人格断言不足以防止有害输出，需要明确的指令引导；建议未来审计LLM的ND适应性时关注可靠性问题。

title: TADI: Tool-Augmented Drilling Intelligence via Agentic LLM Orchestration over Heterogeneous Wellsite Data
summary: We present TADI (Tool-Augmented Drilling Intelligence), an agentic AI system that transforms drilling operational data into evidence-based analytical intelligence. Applied to the Equinor Volve Field dataset, TADI integrates 1,759 daily drilling reports, selected WITSML real-time objects, 15,634 production records, formation tops, and perforations into a dual-store architecture: DuckDB for structured queries over 12 tables with 65,447 rows, and ChromaDB for semantic search over 36,709 embedded documents. Twelve domain-specialized tools, orchestrated by a large language model via iterative function calling, support multi-step evidence gathering that cross-references structured drilling measurements with daily report narratives. The system parses all 1,759 DDR XML files with zero errors, handles three incompatible well naming conventions, and is backed by 95 automated tests plus a 130-question stress-question taxonomy spanning six operational categories. We formalize the agent's behavior as a sequential tool-selection problem and propose the Evidence Grounding Score (EGS) as a simple grounding-compliance proxy based on measurements, attributed DDR quotations, and required answer sections. The complete 6,084-line, framework-free implementation is reproducible given the public Volve download and an API key, and the case studies and qualitative ablation analysis suggest that domain-specialized tool design, rather than model scale alone, is the primary driver of analytical quality in technical operations.

AI.tldr: TADI是一个基于代理AI的钻井智能系统，通过集成结构化数据和语义文档，利用12个领域专用工具和LLM编排，将Equinor Volve油田的操作数据转化为可验证的分析情报，并提出了证据归因分数(EGS)作为评估指标。
AI.motivation: 钻井操作数据分散在结构化数据库和文本报告中，传统方法难以跨模态整合这些信息以支持分析决策。
AI.method: 采用DuckDB+ChromaDB双存储架构，集成12个领域专用工具，由LLM通过迭代函数调用编排，实现多步证据收集与交叉引用。
AI.result: 成功解析全部1,759份DDR XML文件且零错误，处理三种不一致井命名规范，构建95个自动化测试和130个压力测试问题。
AI.conclusion: 领域专用工具设计比模型规模本身更能驱动技术操作中的分析质量。

title: Cultural Benchmarking of LLMs in Standard and Dialectal Arabic Dialogues
summary: There is a significant gap in evaluating cultural reasoning in LLMs using conversational datasets that capture culturally rich and dialectal contexts. Most Arabic benchmarks focus on short text snippets in Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), overlooking the cultural nuances that naturally arise in dialogues. To address this gap, we introduce ArabCulture-Dialogue, a culturally grounded conversational dataset covering 13 Arabic-speaking countries, in both MSA and each country's respective dialect, spanning 12 daily-life topics and 54 fine-grained subtopics. We utilize the dataset to form three benchmarking tasks: (i) multiple-choice cultural reasoning, (ii) machine translation between MSA and dialects, and (iii) dialect-steering generation. Our experiments indicate that the performance gap between MSA and Arabic dialects still exists, whereby the models perform worse on all three tasks in the dialectal setup, compared to the MSA one.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个涵盖13个阿拉伯国家、包含现代标准阿拉伯语和方言的文化对话数据集ArabCulture-Dialogue，并构建了三个基准任务（多选题文化推理、机器翻译、方言导向生成），实验发现模型在方言场景下的表现普遍差于标准阿拉伯语。
AI.motivation: 现有阿拉伯语基准大多使用现代标准阿拉伯语的短文本，忽略了对话中自然蕴含的文化差异和方言语境，导致LLM的文化推理评估存在显著空白。
AI.method: 构建了涵盖13个阿拉伯国家、54个细分子话题、涉及MSA和各国方言的文化对话数据集，并设计了多选题文化推理、MSA与方言间机器翻译、方言导向生成三项评估任务。
AI.result: 在方言设置下，模型在所有三个任务上的表现均差于MSA设置，表明MSA与阿拉伯方言之间的性能差距仍然存在。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM在处理阿拉伯方言和文化语境方面仍存在不足，需要更多关注方言多样性的评估与改进。

title: Two-View Accumulation as the Primary Training Lever for Hybrid-Capture Gaussian Splatting: A Variance-Decomposition View of When Gradient Surgery Helps
summary:
Hybrid-capture novel view synthesis combines images at substantially different camera distances (e.g., aerial drone and ground-level views). Standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), trained for 30K iterations with one rendered view per optimizer step, under-fits the minority regime by 1-3 dB on five hybrid-capture benchmarks. We isolate the lever that closes this gap.
  Among compute-matched alternatives -- vanilla 60K iterations, magnitude corrections (GradNorm), direction-aware near/far gradient surgery, projective preconditioning, confidence-gated sample-level surgery, and a random two-view-per-step control -- the simplest structural change wins: rendering two views per optimizer step. The pairing rule (geometry-defined near/far, random, or active loss-disparity) does not change PSNR beyond seed variance on any of the five scenes; the structural change of having two views per step does.
  We propose a variance-decomposition framework that predicts and explains this finding: under bimodal camera regimes, between-regime gradient variance turns out to be small relative to within-regime variance in 3DGS, so structured and random pairings are variance-equivalent in expectation, and the variance halving from two-view accumulation itself is the dominant effect. We verify the framework on five scenes whose camera-altitude bimodality coefficients span [0.55, 1.00], and we report the negative result that direction-aware projection, magnitude correction, confidence gating, and an active loss-disparity pairing all fall within seed variance of random two-view pairing. The two-view structural lever transfers cleanly to the Scaffold-GS and Pixel-GS backbones.
  We position this work as an honest characterization of which training-side axes do and do not move PSNR for hybrid-capture 3DGS, together with the framework that explains why.

AI.tldr: 在混合视角新视角合成中，将每个优化步骤的渲染视图从1个增加到2个（无论配对方式），是提升3DGS性能最有效且最简洁的方法，效果优于梯度归一化、梯度手术等多种复杂方案。作者通过方差分解框架解释了这一现象：跨视角区域间的梯度方差远小于区域内方差，因此双视图累积带来的方差减半是主要驱动力。
AI.motivation: 混合视角新视角合成（如无人机航拍与地面视角）中，标准3DGS对少数视角区域拟合不足（PSNR低1-3 dB）。作者希望找出能弥补这一差距的关键训练策略。
AI.method: 比较多种计算量匹配的方案：60K迭代、GradNorm、远近梯度手术、投影预条件、置信度门控样本级手术、随机双视图，以及几何定义/随机/主动损失差异的配对规则。提出方差分解框架解释双视图策略的有效性。
AI.result: 最简单的结构改变——每步渲染两个视图——在所有5个场景中胜出。配对规则（远近、随机、主动选择）对PSNR无显著影响。双视图策略在Scaffold-GS和Pixel-GS骨干网络上同样有效。所有方向感知投影、幅度校正等方法均未超越随机双视图配对的种子方差范围。
AI.conclusion: 双视图累积是提升混合视角3DGS最有效的训练侧策略；方差分解框架表明跨区域梯度方差小，双视图主要通过方差减半发挥作用；该结论对多种骨干网络稳健。

title: Timing is Everything: Temporal Scaffolding of Semantic Surprise in Humor
summary: Humor is a fundamental cognitive phenomenon in which humans derive pleasure from the expectation violations and their resolution, exemplifying the brain's dynamic capacity for predictive processing. Classical humor theories emphasize semantic incongruity as the primary driver of amusement, yet overlook temporal dynamics despite comedians' intuition that "timing is everything." The extent to which temporal structure contributes to humor appreciation and how it interacts with semantic content remains poorly understood. Here, we propose the Dual Prediction Violation (DPV) framework to capture the interplay between content and timing. By analyzing 828 professional Chinese stand-up performances, we show that temporal features substantially outweigh semantic incongruity in predicting audience appreciation. Specifically, we find that peak semantic violations matter more than average incongruity levels, and pauses systematically lengthen before high-surprise punchlines--a strategic coupling that distinguishes successful from unsuccessful performances. These findings reframe humor as temporally scaffolded, where timing and semantic content operate in strategic coordination rather than independently. Our DPV framework bridges humor theory with predictive processing, demonstrating that temporal structure plays a central role in naturalistic humor appreciation with implications for understanding multi-scale prediction integration in linguistic processing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双重预测违背（DPV）框架，通过分析828场专业中文单口喜剧表演，发现时间结构（如停顿节奏）比语义 incongruity 更能预测观众幽默欣赏，揭示了幽默中时间与语义内容的协同作用。
AI.motivation: 经典幽默理论强调语义 incongruity 是幽默的主要驱动力，但忽略了时间动态在幽默中的作用，尽管喜剧演员直觉认为"时机就是一切"。时间结构如何贡献于幽默欣赏及其与语义内容的交互作用尚不清楚。
AI.method: 提出DPV框架，分析828场专业中文单口喜剧表演，比较时间特征与语义 incongruity 对观众欣赏的预测能力，并考察高潮前停顿模式与语义惊喜水平的关系。
AI.result: 时间特征显著优于语义 incongruity 预测观众欣赏；峰值语义违背比平均 incongruity 水平更重要；高风险笑点前停顿系统性延长，这种策略性耦合区分了成功与不成功的表演。
AI.conclusion: 幽默是时间支撑的，时间与语义内容以策略性协调而非独立方式运作。DPV框架将幽默理论与预测加工理论桥接，表明时间结构在自然主义幽默欣赏中起核心作用。

title: AIDA-ReID: Adaptive Intermediate Domain Adaptation for Generalizable and Source-Free Person Re-Identification
summary: Person re-identification (Re-ID) aims to match images of the same individual across non-overlapping camera views and remains challenging due to domain shifts caused by variations in illumination, background, camera characteristics, and population distributions. Although supervised models perform well under matched training and testing conditions, their performance degrades significantly when deployed in unseen environments. Existing intermediate domain approaches such as IDM and IDM++ alleviate this gap by constructing bridge feature distributions between domains; however, they rely on fixed mixing strategies and joint source-target access, limiting their applicability to multi-source and source-free settings. To address these limitations, this paper proposes Adaptive Intermediate Domain Adaptation (AIDA), also referred to as Source-Free Multi-Source Intermediate Domain Adaptation (SF-MIDA). The proposed framework treats intermediate-domain learning as a dynamically regulated process, where feature mixing and regularization strength are adaptively controlled using feedback signals derived from model uncertainty and training stability. A multi-source intermediate domain generator synthesizes diverse intermediate representations, while a pseudo-mirror regularization strategy preserves identity consistency under domain perturbations. Extensive experiments across domain generalization and source-free settings demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应中间域适应框架AIDA（SF-MIDA），通过动态特征混合与伪镜像正则化解决多源和无源场景下行人重识别的域自适应问题。
AI.motivation: 现有中间域方法（如IDM/IDM++）依赖固定混合策略和联合源-目标访问，难以适用于多源和无源环境，导致模型在未知域中性能下降。
AI.method: 提出AIDA框架：1）多源中间域生成器合成多样中间特征；2）基于模型不确定性和训练稳定性的动态调控机制自适应调节混合强度与正则化系数；3）伪镜像正则化策略保持域扰动下的身份一致性。
AI.result: 在域泛化和无源设定下的广泛实验验证了该框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: AIDA通过动态自适应机制有效克服了固定混合策略的局限性，为多源和无源场景下的行人重识别域自适应提供了可行方案。

title: Minimal, Local, Causal Explanations for Jailbreak Success in Large Language Models
summary: Safety trained large language models (LLMs) can often be induced to answer harmful requests through jailbreak prompts. Because we lack a robust understanding of why LLMs are susceptible to jailbreaks, future frontier models operating more autonomously in higher-stakes settings may similarly be vulnerable to such attacks. Prior work has studied jailbreak success by examining the model's intermediate representations, identifying directions in this space that causally encode concepts like harmfulness and refusal. Then, they globally explain all jailbreak attacks as attempting to reduce or strengthen these concepts (e.g., reduce harmfulness). However, different jailbreak strategies may succeed by strengthening or suppressing different intermediate concepts, and the same jailbreak strategy may not work for different harmful request categories (e.g., violence vs. cyberattack); thus, we seek to give a local explanation -- i.e., why did this specific jailbreak succeed? To address this gap, we introduce LOCA, a method that gives Local, CAusal explanations of jailbreak success by identifying a minimal set of interpretable, intermediate representation changes that causally induce model refusal on an otherwise successful jailbreak request. We evaluate LOCA on harmful original-jailbreak pairs from a large jailbreak benchmark across Gemma and Llama chat models, comparing against prior methods adapted to this setting. LOCA can successfully induce refusal by making, on average, six interpretable changes; prior work routinely fails to achieve refusal even after 20 changes. LOCA is a step toward mechanistic, local explanations of jailbreak success in LLMs. Code to be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LOCA方法，通过识别最小可解释的中间表征变化来解释特定越狱攻击为何成功，平均仅需6处改变即可使模型拒绝有害请求。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将越狱攻击全局归因为削弱"有害性"或"拒绝"等概念，但不同越狱策略可能通过改变不同中间概念来实现，且同一策略对不同类别有害请求效果不同，因此需要局部解释。
AI.method: 提出LOCA（Local Causal Explanations）方法，通过识别一组最小且可解释的中间表征变化，因果性地诱导模型对原本成功的越狱请求产生拒绝。
AI.result: 在Gemma和Llama聊天模型的大型越狱基准测试上，LOCA平均仅需6个可解释改变即可成功诱导拒绝，而先前方法即使进行20次改变也常失败。
AI.conclusion: LOCA是迈向LLM越狱成功机制的局部解释的重要一步。

title: RSAT: Structured Attribution Makes Small Language Models Faithful Table Reasoners
comment: 8 pages, 8 tables, 9 figures, and a 3-page Appendix. Accepted at the SURGeLLM Workshop at ACL 2026 and will be included in the proceedings
summary: When a language model answers a table question, users have no way to verify which cells informed which reasoning steps. We introduce RSAT, a method that trains small language models (SLMs, 1-8B) to produce step-by-step reasoning with cell-level citations grounded in table evidence. Phase 1 (SFT) teaches a structured JSON output format from verified reasoning traces. Phase 2 (GRPO) optimizes a composite reward centered on NLI-based faithfulness, alongside citation validity and parsimony. Across six models from two families-Qwen 2.5 (1.5B/3B/7B) and Llama 3 (1B/3B/8B)-RSAT improves faithfulness 3.7$\times$ over SFT alone (0.224$\rightarrow$0.826), with near-perfect citation validity (0.992). Post-hoc attribution collapses below 13% format success, confirming that attribution must be integrated into reasoning, not retrofitted. Ablations show the faithfulness reward is essential: removing it drops faithfulness from 0.97 to 0.03.

AI.tldr: RSAT通过两阶段训练（SFT+GRPO）让小语言模型在表格问答中生成带单元格引用的逐步推理，相比纯SFT忠实度提升3.7倍，且必须将归因内嵌于推理过程中。
AI.motivation: 用户无法验证语言模型在回答表格问题时，哪些单元格支撑了哪些推理步骤，缺乏可解释性和可信度。
AI.method: 两阶段训练方法：阶段1使用SFT教会模型从已验证推理轨迹中输出结构化JSON格式；阶段2使用GRPO优化基于NLI的忠实度、引用有效性和简洁性组成的复合奖励。
AI.result: 在Qwen 2.5和Llama 3两个系列共6个模型上，RSAT将忠实度从0.224提升至0.826（提升3.7倍），引用有效性接近完美（0.992）；事后归因的格式成功率低于13%。
AI.conclusion: 归因必须集成到推理过程中而非事后添加，忠实度奖励是核心组件，去除后忠实度从0.97骤降至0.03。

title: GAFSV-Net: A Vision Framework for Online Signature Verification
summary: Online signature verification (OSV) requires distinguishing skilled forgeries from genuine samples under high intra-class variability and with very few enrollment samples. Existing deep learning methods operate directly on raw temporal sequences, restricting them to 1D architectures and preventing the use of pretrained 2D vision backbones. We bridge this gap with GAFSV-Net, which represents each signature as a six-channel asymmetric Gramian Angular Field image: three kinematic channels (pen speed, pressure derivative, direction angle) are each encoded into complementary GASF and GADF matrices that capture pairwise temporal co-occurrence and directional transition structure respectively. A dual-branch ConvNeXt-Tiny encoder processes GASF and GADF independently, with bidirectional cross-attention enabling each branch to query discriminative patterns from the other before metric-space projection. Training uses semi-hard triplet loss with skilled-forgery hard-negative injection; verification is performed via cosine similarity against a small enrollment prototype. We evaluate on DeepSignDB and BiosecurID, outperforming all sequence-based baselines trained under identical objectives, demonstrating that the representational gain of 2D temporal encoding is consistent and independent of training procedure, with ablations characterising each design choice's contribution.

AI.tldr: 提出GAFSV-Net，将在线签名转换为六通道Gramian Angular Field图像，利用2D视觉骨干网络进行签名验证，在DeepSignDB和BiosecurID上超越所有序列方法。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法直接在原始时间序列上操作，受限于1D架构，无法利用预训练的2D视觉骨干网络。
AI.method: 将签名时间序列编码为六通道GAF图像（GASF和GADF），使用双分支ConvNeXt-Tiny编码器，双向交叉注意力融合，半困难三元组损失训练。
AI.result: 在DeepSignDB和BiosecurID上，超越所有基于序列的基线方法，2D时序编码的表示增益是稳健且独立的。
AI.conclusion: 将在线签名转换为2D图像表示可以有效利用视觉骨干网络，显著提升在线签名验证性能。

title: Are Tools All We Need? Unveiling the Tool-Use Tax in LLM Agents
summary: Tool-augmented reasoning has become a popular direction for LLM-based agents, and it is widely assumed to improve reasoning and reliability. However, we demonstrate that this consensus does not always hold: in the presence of semantic distractors, tool-augmented reasoning does not necessarily outperform native CoT. To explain this performance gap, we propose a Factorized Intervention Framework that isolates the cost of prompt formatting, the overhead of the tool-calling protocol, and the actual gain from executing tools. Our analysis reveals a critical tradeoff: under semantic noise, the gains from tools often fail to offset the "tool-use tax", which is the performance degradation introduced by the tool-calling protocol itself. To address this, we introduce G-STEP, a lightweight inference-time gate to mitigate protocol-induced errors. While this yields partial recovery, our findings suggest that more substantial improvements still require strengthening the model's intrinsic reasoning and tool-interaction capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文发现工具增强推理在语义干扰下并不总是优于原生思维链，提出了因子化干预框架分析工具使用的性能代价，并引入G-STEP轻量门控机制来缓解协议引入的错误。
AI.motivation: 尽管工具增强推理被广泛认为能提升LLM的推理能力和可靠性，但作者发现这一共识并不总是成立：在存在语义干扰项的情况下，工具增强推理并不一定优于原生思维链（CoT）。作者希望解释这一性能差距背后的原因。
AI.method: 提出因子化干预框架（Factorized Intervention Framework），将性能差异分解为三个因素：提示格式化的成本、工具调用协议的开销、以及执行工具带来的实际收益。在此基础上提出G-STEP（轻量级推理时门控机制）来缓解协议引入的错误。
AI.result: 在语义噪声下，工具带来的增益往往无法抵消"工具使用税"（tool-use tax），即工具调用协议本身引入的性能退化。G-STEP能够实现部分恢复，但更多改进仍需要增强模型自身的推理能力和工具交互能力。
AI.conclusion: 工具增强推理并非总是优于原生推理，语义干扰下存在工具使用税这一关键权衡。轻量级门控机制可部分缓解问题，但根本提升仍需强化模型的内在推理和工具交互能力。

title: TUR-DPO: Topology- and Uncertainty-Aware Direct Preference Optimization
comment: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences is commonly done via reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) or, more simply, via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). While DPO is stable and RL-free, it treats preferences as flat winner vs. loser signals and is sensitive to noisy or brittle preferences arising from fragile chains of thought. We propose TUR-DPO, a topology- and uncertainty-aware variant of DPO that rewards how answers are derived, not only what they say, by eliciting lightweight reasoning topologies and combining semantic faithfulness, utility, and topology quality into a calibrated uncertainty signal. A small learnable reward is factorized over these signals and incorporated into an uncertainty-weighted DPO objective that remains RL-free and relies only on a fixed or moving reference policy. Empirically, across open 7-8B models and benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, factual question answering, summarization, and helpful/harmless dialogue, TUR-DPO improves judge win-rates, faithfulness, and calibration relative to DPO while preserving training simplicity and avoiding online rollouts. We further observe consistent gains in multimodal and long-context settings, and show that TUR-DPO matches or exceeds PPO on reasoning-centric tasks while maintaining operational simplicity.

AI.tldr: TUR-DPO是一种基于拓扑和不确定性的DPO变体，通过推理拓扑结构、语义忠实度和不确定性加权信号来改进偏好对齐，无需强化学习即可在多项任务上超越标准DPO并媲美PPO。
AI.motivation: 标准DPO将偏好视为平坦的胜负信号，对源自脆弱推理链的噪声或脆弱的偏好敏感，缺乏对答案推导过程的考量。
AI.method: 提出TUR-DPO，引入轻量级推理拓扑结构，结合语义忠实度、效用和拓扑质量构建校准的不确定性信号，将可学习的奖励因子化到这些信号中，并纳入不确定性加权的DPO目标函数。
AI.result: 在7-8B开源模型上，数学推理、事实问答、摘要、对话等任务中，相比DPO提升了评判胜率、忠实度和校准性；在多模态和长上下文场景中也有持续提升；在推理密集型任务上匹配或超越PPO。
AI.conclusion: TUR-DPO在保持训练简洁性、无需在线 rollout 的情况下，有效提升了模型对齐的质量和鲁棒性。

title: Why Do LLMs Struggle in Strategic Play? Broken Links Between Observations, Beliefs, and Actions
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly tasked with strategic decision-making under incomplete information, such as in negotiation and policymaking. While LLMs can excel at many such tasks, they also fail in ways that are poorly understood. We shed light on these failures by uncovering two fundamental gaps in the internal mechanisms underlying the decision-making of LLMs in incomplete-information games, supported by experiments with open-weight models Llama 3.1, Qwen3, and gpt-oss. First, an observation-belief gap: LLMs encode internal beliefs about latent game states that are substantially more accurate than their own verbal reports, yet these beliefs are brittle. In particular, the belief accuracy degrades with multi-hop reasoning, exhibits primacy and recency biases, and drifts away from Bayesian coherence over extended interactions. Second, a belief-action gap: The implicit conversion of internal beliefs into actions is weaker than that of the beliefs externalized in the prompt, yet neither belief-conditioning consistently achieves higher game payoffs. These results show how analyzing LLMs' internal processes can expose systematic vulnerabilities that warrant caution before deploying LLMs in strategic domains without robust guardrails.

AI.tldr: 通过分析LLMs在非完全信息博弈中的内部机制，发现了两个根本性缺陷：观察-信念差距（内部信念比口头报告更准确但脆弱）和信念-行动差距（内部信念到行动的转换比外部化信念更弱），揭示了LLMs在战略决策中的系统性脆弱性。
AI.motivation: LLMs越来越多地用于不完全信息下的战略决策（如谈判、政策制定），虽然它们在某些任务上表现出色，但在其他情况下却会失败，而失败的原因尚未被充分理解。
AI.method: 通过实验分析Llama 3.1、Qwen3和gpt-oss等开源权重模型在非完全信息博弈中的内部决策机制，研究内部信念编码、信念准确度变化以及信念到行动的转换过程。
AI.result: 1) 观察-信念差距：LLMs内部编码的信念显著比其口头报告更准确，但这些信念很脆弱，在多跳推理中准确度下降，存在首因和近因偏差，且随交互增加偏离贝叶斯一致性。2) 信念-行动差距：内部信念到行动的转换弱于外部化信念到行动的转换，且两种信念条件均不能持续获得更高博弈收益。
AI.conclusion: 分析LLMs的内部过程可以暴露系统性漏洞，在缺乏稳健护栏的情况下，将LLMs部署到战略领域需谨慎。

title: ARMOR 2025: A Military-Aligned Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Model Safety Beyond Civilian Contexts
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are now being explored for defense applications that require reliable and legally compliant decision support. They also hold significant potential to enhance decision making, coordination, and operational efficiency in military contexts. These uses demand evaluation methods that reflect the doctrinal standards that guide real military operations. Existing safety benchmarks focus on general social risks and do not test whether models follow the legal and ethical rules that govern real military operations. To address this gap, we introduce ARMOR 2025, a military aligned safety benchmark grounded in three core military doctrines the Law of War, the Rules of Engagement, and the Joint Ethics Regulation. We extract doctrinal text from these sources and generate multiple choice questions that preserve the intended meaning of each rule. The benchmark is organized through a taxonomy informed by the Observe Orient Decide Act (OODA) decision making framework. This structure enables systematic testing of accuracy and refusal across military relevant decision types. This benchmark features a structured 12-category taxonomy, 519 doctrinally grounded prompts, and rigorous evaluation procedures applied to 21 commercial LLMs. Evaluation results reveal critical gaps in safety alignment for military applications.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型在军事防御应用中的安全对齐问题，提出了ARMOR 2025基准，基于三大军事教义（战争法、交战规则、联合伦理条例）构建了519个教义驱动的选择题，并对21个商业LLM进行评估，揭示了其在军事场景中的安全对齐关键缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有安全基准仅关注一般社会风险，未能测试模型是否遵循指导真实军事行动的法律和伦理规则，而LLM正被探索用于需要可靠且合法决策支持的国防应用。
AI.method: 从战争法、交战规则、联合伦理条例三大军事教义中提取文本，生成保留原意的多项选择题；基于OODA（观察-定向-决策-行动）决策框架构建12类别分类体系，对21个商业LLM进行准确性和拒绝回答能力评估。
AI.result: 构建了包含519个教义驱动提示的基准，在21个商业LLM上的评估揭示了军事应用安全对齐方面的关键缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM在军事场景下的安全对齐存在严重不足，ARMOR 2025为评估和改进模型在军事领域的合规性提供了有效工具。

title: VkSplat: High-Performance 3DGS Training in Vulkan Compute
summary: We present VkSplat, a high-performance, cross-vendor 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) training pipeline implemented fully in Vulkan compute, addressing performance and compatibility limitation of existing training pipelines. With various optimizations, we achieve $3.3\times$ speed and $33\%$ VRAM reduction over CUDA+PyTorch baseline, maintaining quality, and demonstrating compatibility across GPU vendors. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first fully-Vulkan-based 3DGS training pipeline that achieves state-of-the-art performance. Code: \href{https://github.com/harry7557558/vksplat}{https://github.com/harry7557558/vksplat}

AI.tldr: VkSplat 是一个完全基于 Vulkan compute 实现的跨厂商 3DGS 训练管线，相比 CUDA+PyTorch 基线实现了 3.3 倍加速和 33% 显存降低，是首个达到 SOTA 性能的全 Vulkan 3DGS 训练管线。
AI.motivation: 现有 3DGS 训练管线在性能和跨厂商兼容性方面存在局限，作者希望解决这两个问题。
AI.method: 完全基于 Vulkan compute 实现 3DGS 训练管线，并进行了多种优化。
AI.result: 相比 CUDA+PyTorch 基线实现了 3.3 倍训练加速和 33% 的显存降低，且保持质量不变，具备跨 GPU 厂商的兼容性。
AI.conclusion: VkSplat 是首个完全基于 Vulkan 且达到 SOTA 性能的 3DGS 训练管线，有效解决了性能和兼容性限制。

title: Causal Foundations of Collective Agency
summary: A key challenge for the safety of advanced AI systems is the possibility that multiple simpler agents might inadvertently form a collective agent with capabilities and goals distinct from those of any individual. More generally, determining when a group of agents can be viewed as a unified collective agent is a foundational question in the study of interactions and incentives in both biological and artificial systems. We adopt a behavioral perspective in answering this question, ascribing collective agency to a group when viewing the group's joint actions as rational and goal-directed successfully predicts its behavior. We formalize this perspective on collective agency using causal games -- which are causal models of strategic, multi-agent interactions -- and causal abstraction -- which formalizes when a simple, high-level model faithfully captures a more complex, low-level model. We use this framework to solve a puzzle regarding multi-agent incentives in actor-critic models and to make quantitative assessments of the degree of collective agency exhibited by different voting mechanisms. Our framework aims to provide a foundation for theoretical and empirical work to understand, predict, and control emergent collective agents in multi-agent AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于因果博弈和因果抽象的形式化框架，用于判断多智能体系统何时可被视为统一集体智能体，并量化其集体能动性程度。
AI.motivation: 先进AI系统中多个简单智能体可能无意中形成具有独特能力和目标的集体智能体，这带来了安全挑战。需要一种形式化方法来识别和预测何时一组智能体可被视为统一集体。
AI.method: 采用行为视角，通过因果博弈（多智能体交互的因果模型）和因果抽象（高层模型忠实捕捉低层模型的框架）来形式化集体能动性。提出当将群体的联合行动视为理性且目标导向时能成功预测其行为，则该群体被视为集体智能体。
AI.result: 解决了演员-评论家模型中多智能体激励的难题，并对不同投票机制所展现的集体能动性程度进行了量化评估。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为理解和预测多智能体AI系统中涌现的集体智能体提供了理论基础，有助于控制和引导此类系统的行为，提升AI安全性。

title: Estimating LLM Grading Ability and Response Difficulty in Automatic Short Answer Grading via Item Response Theory
summary: Automated short answer grading (ASAG) with large language models (LLMs) is commonly evaluated with aggregate metrics such as macro-F1 and Cohen's kappa. However, these metrics provide limited insight into how grading performance varies across student responses of differing grading difficulty. We introduce an evaluation framework for LLM-based ASAG based on item response theory (IRT), which models grading correctness as a function of latent grader ability and response grading difficulty. This formulation enables response-level analysis of where LLM graders succeed or fail and reveals robustness differences that are not visible from aggregate scores alone. We apply the framework to 17 open-weight LLMs on the SciEntsBank and Beetle benchmarks. The results show that even models with similar overall performance differ substantially in how sharply their grading accuracy declines as response difficulty increases. In addition, confusion patterns show that errors on difficult responses concentrate disproportionately on the \texttt{partially\_correct\_incomplete} label, indicating a tendency toward intermediate-label collapse under ambiguity. To characterize difficult responses, we further analyze semantic and linguistic correlates of estimated difficulty. Across both datasets, higher difficulty is associated with weaker semantic alignment to the reference answer, stronger contradiction signals, and greater semantic isolation in embedding space. Overall, these results show that item response theory offers a useful framework for evaluating LLM-based ASAG beyond aggregate performance measures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于项目反应理论(IRT)的评估框架，用于分析大语言模型在自动简答题评分中的表现，揭示不同难度题目下的评分能力差异，发现模型在困难题目上倾向于将答案误判为"部分正确/不完整"，并分析了困难题目的语义和语言学特征。
AI.motivation: 传统聚合指标(如macro-F1和Cohen's kappa)无法揭示LLM评分器在不同难度题目上的性能差异，需要更细粒度的评估方法。
AI.method: 基于项目反应理论(IRT)构建评估框架，将评分正确性建模为潜在评分者能力和响应评分难度的函数，在SciEntsBank和Beetle两个基准上对17个开源LLM进行实验，并分析语义和语言学相关特征。
AI.result: 1) 性能相近的模型在难度下降趋势上存在显著差异；2) 错误集中在partially_correct_incomplete标签上，存在中间标签坍缩倾向；3) 高难度响应与参考答案语义对齐弱、矛盾信号强、嵌入空间语义孤立度高相关。
AI.conclusion: 项目反应理论为评估基于LLM的自动简答题评分提供了超越聚合性能指标的有用框架。

title: Adaptive Geodesic Conformal Prediction for Egocentric Camera Pose Estimation
summary: Egocentric pose estimation for Augmented Reality (AR) and assistive devices requires not just accurate predictions but guaranteed uncertainty regions. Conformal prediction (CP) provides such guarantees without retraining, but we show that standard CP with a single fixed threshold achieves nominal 90% overall coverage while covering only ~60% of the hardest 25% of frames (Q4) -- a ~30 percentage-point conditional coverage gap consistent across 12 participants, 3 predictors, and 3 horizons (108 evaluations) on EPIC-Fields. We further show that a geodesic SE(3) nonconformity score identifies physically harder frames than Euclidean scoring, with only 15-26% Q4 overlap and 2-3x higher ground-truth camera displacement for geodesic Q4 frames. To close the coverage gap, we propose DINOv2-Bridge adaptive CP: a two-stage difficulty estimator trained on a single source participant that transfers cross-participant without any images at test time, improving Q4 coverage from ~0.75 to ~0.93 while maintaining overall coverage at the 90% target.

AI.tldr: 本文针对AR和辅助设备中的自我中心姿态估计，发现标准共形预测在难度大的帧上覆盖率显著下降（从90%降至约60%），并提出了基于DINOv2-Bridge的自适应共形预测方法，将困难帧覆盖率从约0.75提升至约0.93。
AI.motivation: 现有共形预测方法在整体上能达到标称覆盖率，但在困难帧（如快速运动、复杂场景）上存在严重的条件覆盖缺口（约30个百分点），这在实际AR/辅助设备应用中是不可接受的。
AI.method: 1. 提出基于测地线SE(3)的非一致性分数，比欧几里得分数更能识别物理上困难的帧；2. 提出DINOv2-Bridge自适应共形预测，在单个源参与者上训练两阶段难度估计器，无需测试图像即可跨参与者迁移。
AI.result: 标准CP在Q4（最困难25%帧）覆盖率仅约60%，而DINOv2-Bridge自适应CP将Q4覆盖率从约0.75提升至约0.93，同时保持整体90%的目标覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了标准共形预测在自我中心姿态估计中的条件覆盖缺口，并证明了无需测试图像即可跨参与者迁移的自适应方法能有效弥补这一缺口。

title: Agentic AI for Trip Planning Optimization Application
summary: Trip planning for intelligent vehicles increasingly requires selecting optimal routes rather than merely producing feasible itineraries, as interacting factors such as travel time, energy consumption, and traffic conditions directly affect plan quality. Yet existing systems are largely designed for feasibility-oriented planning, and current benchmarks provide only reference answers without ground truth, preventing objective evaluation of optimization performance. In our paper, we address these limitations with an agentic AI framework that enables dynamic refinement through an orchestration agent coordinating specialized agents for traffic, charging, and points of interest, and with the Trip-planning Optimization Problems Dataset, which supplies definitive optimal solutions and category-level task structure for fine-grained analysis. Experiments show that our system achieves 77.4\% accuracy on the TOP Benchmark, significantly outperforming single-agent and workflow-based multi-agent baselines, demonstrating the importance of orchestrated agentic reasoning for robust trip planning optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于智能体AI的旅行规划优化框架，并构建了包含最优解和类别级任务结构的TOP数据集，实验表明该框架在TOP基准测试中达到77.4%的准确率，显著优于单智能体和工作流式多智能体基线。
AI.motivation: 现有旅行规划系统主要面向可行性规划，缺乏优化能力；同时现有基准测试仅提供参考答案而无最优解，无法客观评估优化性能。
AI.method: 提出智能体AI框架，通过编排智能体协调专门处理交通、充电和兴趣点的子智能体，实现动态优化；同时构建Trip-planning Optimization Problems Dataset，提供确定的最优解和类别级任务结构。
AI.result: 在TOP基准测试上达到77.4%的准确率，显著优于单智能体和工作流式多智能体基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 编排式智能体推理对于稳健的旅行规划优化至关重要，证明了所提框架的有效性。

title: Lost in State Space: Probing Frozen Mamba Representations
summary: Mamba's recurrent state h_t is, by construction, a compressed summary of every token seen so far. This raises a tempting hypothesis: if we extract token-level outputs y_t at fixed patch boundaries, we obtain semantic sentence summaries for free, with no pooling head, no fine-tuning, and no [CLS] token. We test this hypothesis carefully. Across five benchmarks (SST-2, CoLA, MRPC, STS-B, IMDb), we compare four strategies for extracting frozen sentence representations from a pretrained Mamba-130M backbone under a strict frozen-feature probing protocol, using three random seeds where computationally feasible. The results do not support the hypothesis: patch boundary readouts do not consistently outperform simple mean pooling. We identify and quantify two structural pathologies: severe anisotropy (mean pairwise cosine similarity 0.9999, std 0.000044) and representational collapse in the raw final SSM state (MCC = 0.000 on CoLA across all three seeds, confirmed via confusion matrix). AI.tldr: 本文验证了Mamba模型的状态向量能否作为句子摘要的假设，结果发现该假设不成立：直接取状态向量做句子表示效果并不优于简单平均池化，且存在严重的各向异性和表示崩塌问题。作者进一步提出正交注入方法以缓解这些问题。
AI.motivation: 探索能否直接利用Mamba循环状态h_t在固定边界处的输出作为语义级别的句子摘要表示，从而避免额外的池化层、微调或特殊标记。
AI.method: 在五个基准数据集（SST-2、CoLA、MRPC、STS-B、IMDb）上，比较四种从预训练Mamba-130M骨干提取冻结句子表示的策略，采用严格冻结特征探测协议，并使用三个随机种子进行实验。
AI.result: 四种策略中，直接读取状态边界输出并不一致优于简单平均池化；SSM状态存在严重各向异性（平均余弦相似度0.9999，标准差0.000044）和表示崩塌（CoLA上MCC=0.000，三个种子一致）。
AI.conclusion: 原始假设不成立，Mamba状态向量不能作为有效的句子摘要；需通过正交注入等改进来约束新信息，以缓解表示质量问题。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning for Chartered Accountancy
summary: The inception of Large Language Models (LLMs) has catalyzed AI adoption in the finance sector, yet their reliability in complex, jurisdiction-specific tasks like Indian Chartered Accountancy (CA) remains limited. The models display difficulty in executing numerical tasks which require multiple steps while also needing advanced knowledge about legal regulations and the method of scaling their operations is not feasible in settings which have limited access to resources. We present CA-ThinkFlow as a parameter-efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework which operates with a 14B, 4-bit-quantized reasoning model, 14B-DeepSeek-R1, and a layout-aware Docling extraction system which maintains document structure during extraction. CA-ThinkFlow uses a basic RAG method which automatically adds retrieved information into the prompt, while it depends on the model's built-in Chain-of-Thought (CoT) functions to create context and produce correct answers. The system we developed system operates at performance levels which match large proprietary models when we tested it on the multi-level CA-Ben benchmark, achieving Scholastic Reliability Coefficient (SRC) results which equal 68.75\% of GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet. The framework shows high efficiency and strength in handling parameters, but essential reasoning abilities fail to process complex regulatory texts which exist in fields such as Taxation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CA-ThinkFlow，一个参数高效的RAG框架，使用14B量化推理模型和Docling文档提取系统，在印度特许会计师考试基准上达到GPT-4o和Claude 3.5 Sonnet 68.75%的可靠性水平，但在税务等复杂法规文本推理上仍有不足。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在金融领域应用广泛，但在处理印度特许会计师考试这类复杂、跨管辖区的数值推理任务时表现不佳，且存在多步数值计算困难、需掌握法律知识、资源受限难以扩展等问题。
AI.method: 提出CA-ThinkFlow框架，采用参数高效的RAG方法，使用14B、4-bit量化的DeepSeek-R1推理模型，结合布局感知的Docling文档提取系统保持文档结构，通过模型内置的Chain-of-Thought功能自动生成上下文并产生正确答案。
AI.result: 在CA-Ben基准测试中，CA-ThinkFlow的Scholastic Reliability Coefficient达到GPT-4o和Claude 3.5 Sonnet的68.75%，性能与大型专有模型相当，且参数效率高、鲁棒性强。
AI.conclusion: CA-ThinkFlow在参数效率和性能之间取得了良好平衡，但在处理税务等领域的复杂法规文本时，其核心推理能力仍然不足，需要进一步改进。

title: Remote SAMsing: From Segment Anything to Segment Everything
summary: SAM2 produces high-quality zero-shot segmentation on natural images, but applying it to large remote sensing scenes exposes two problems: (1) its mask generator faces an inherent quality-coverage trade-off: strict thresholds yield precise masks but leave most of the image unsegmented, while relaxed thresholds increase coverage at the cost of mask quality; and (2) large images must be tiled, fragmenting objects across tile boundaries. We propose Remote SAMsing, an open-source pipeline that solves both problems without modifying SAM2 or requiring training data. For coverage, a multi-pass algorithm runs SAM2 repeatedly on each tile, painting accepted masks black between passes to simplify the scene for the next iteration, and relaxing quality thresholds only when coverage gains stagnate, ensuring that the most precise masks are always captured first. For spatial consistency, contextual padding and a parameter-free best-match merge reconstruct objects fragmented across tile boundaries. Evaluated on seven scenes (5~cm to 4.78~m GSD), the pipeline raises coverage from 30--68\% (single-pass SAM2) to 91--98\%. Ablation experiments quantify the contribution of each component to coverage and detection quality. Per-class evaluation shows that SAM2 transfers well to discrete RS objects (buildings 95\%, cars 82--93\% Det@0.5) with segment boundaries 3--8$\times$ more precise than SLIC and Felzenszwalb baselines. Tile size functions as an implicit scale parameter: reducing it from $1{,}000$ to 250 raises Det@0.5 from 56\% to 85\%, outperforming SAM2's built-in multi-scale mechanism. The pipeline generalizes to MNF false-color imagery without retraining (99.5\% ASA) and scales to production-sized images: a 1.94 billion pixel Potsdam mosaic achieved 97\% coverage without quality degradation.

AI.tldr: 提出Remote SAMsing管道，通过多轮掩码生成和上下文填充拼接，在不修改SAM2或需要训练数据的情况下，解决了遥感大图中零样本分割的质量-覆盖权衡和跨瓦片碎片化问题，覆盖率从30-68%提升至91-98%。
AI.motivation: SAM2在自然图像上表现优异，但直接应用于大幅面遥感影像时存在两个问题：(1) 掩码生成器内在的质量-覆盖权衡——严格阈值导致精确但覆盖率低，宽松阈值提高覆盖但降低质量；(2) 大图必须分块处理，导致物体在瓦片边界处被割裂。
AI.method: 提出Remote SAMsing管道，包含：(1) 多通道算法——在每个瓦片上重复运行SAM2，每次将已接受的掩码区域涂黑，仅当覆盖增益停滞时才放松质量阈值，确保高精度掩码优先捕获；(2) 上下文填充和无参数最佳匹配合并机制，重建跨瓦片边界的碎片化物体。
AI.result: 在7个场景（5cm-4.78m GSD）上，覆盖率从单次SAM2的30-68%提升至91-98%。消融实验量化了各组件贡献。建筑物检测95%，车辆82-93% Det@0.5，边界精度比SLIC和Felzenszwalb基线高3-8倍。瓦片大小可作为隐式尺度参数。在MNF假彩色影像上无需重新训练即可泛化（99.5% ASA），19.4亿像素Potsdam马赛克实现97%覆盖且质量无损。
AI.conclusion: Remote SAMsing以零训练、零修改SAM2的方式，有效解决了大尺度遥感影像分割的质量-覆盖权衡和跨瓦片碎片化问题，具备强泛化能力和工业级规模可扩展性。

title: AgentFloor: How Far Up the tool use Ladder Can Small Open-Weight Models Go?
summary: Production agentic systems make many model calls per user request, and most of those calls are short, structured, and routine. This raises a practical routing question that existing evaluations do not directly answer: which parts of an agent workflow truly require large frontier intelligence, and which can be handled by smaller models? We introduce AgentFloor, a deterministic 30-task benchmark organized as a six-tier capability ladder, spanning instruction following, tool use, multi-step coordination, and long-horizon planning under persistent constraints. We evaluate 16 open-weight models, from 0.27B to 32B parameters, alongside GPT-5 across 16,542 scored runs. Our results reveal a clear boundary of model necessity. Small and mid-sized open-weight models are already sufficient for much of the short-horizon, structured tool use work that dominates real agent pipelines, and in aggregate, the strongest open-weight model matches GPT-5 on our benchmark while being substantially cheaper and faster to run. The gap appears most clearly on long-horizon planning tasks that require sustained coordination and reliable constraint tracking over many steps, where frontier models still hold an advantage, though neither side reaches strong reliability. We also find that this boundary is not explained by scale alone: some failures respond to targeted interventions, but the effects are model-specific rather than universal. These findings suggest a practical design principle for agentic systems: use smaller open-weight models for the broad base of routine actions, and reserve large frontier models for the narrower class of tasks that truly demand deeper planning and control. We release the benchmark, harness, sweep configurations, and full run corpus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AgentFloor基准，通过30个确定性任务评估模型在智能体工作流中的能力。发现小型开放模型足以处理大部分常规工具使用任务，而长程规划仍需前沿模型，但两者均未达到高可靠性。
AI.motivation: 当前生产级智能体系统每个用户请求需要多次模型调用，但现有评估无法回答：哪些工作流部分真正需要大模型，哪些可由小模型处理。
AI.method: 构建AgentFloor，包含30个确定性任务、六层能力阶梯（指令跟随、工具使用、多步协调、长程规划等），对16个开放模型（0.27B-32B）和GPT-5进行了16,542次评分运行。
AI.result: 中小型开放模型足以处理短程结构化工具使用任务；最强开放模型在基准上匹配GPT-5且更便宜更快；差距主要体现在长程规划任务；边界不单纯由模型规模解释，干预效果具有模型特异性。
AI.conclusion: 建议智能体系统设计原则：常规任务使用小型开放模型，仅在需要深层规划和控制时预留大型前沿模型。

title: How Language Models Process Out-of-Distribution Inputs: A Two-Pathway Framework
comment: 30 pages, 3 figures, 30+ tables. Submitted to COLM 2026
summary: Recent white-box OOD detection methods for LLMs -- including CED, RAUQ, and WildGuard confidence scores -- appear effective, but we show they are structurally confounded by sequence length (|r| >= 0.61) and collapse to near-chance under length-matched evaluation. Even raw attention entropy (mean H(alpha) across heads and layers), a natural baseline we include for completeness, shows the same confound. The confound stems from attention's Theta(log T) dependence on input length. To identify genuine OOD signals after deconfounding, we propose a two-pathway framework: embeddings capture what text is about (effective for topic shifts), while the processing trajectory -- hidden-state evolution across layers -- captures how the model processes input. The relative power of each pathway varies along a vocabulary-transparency spectrum: embedding methods excel on vocabulary-distinctive OOD, while trajectory features detect covert-intent inputs that share vocabulary with normal text (0.721 avg AUROC; Jailbreak: 0.850). Three evidence lines support this framework: (1) a crossover between k-NN and trajectory scoring across 6 tasks, where each pathway wins on different OOD types; (2) a per-layer analysis showing that layer-0 k-NN signal is almost entirely a length artifact (Jailbreak: 0.759 raw -> 0.389 matched) -- processing constructs genuine OOD signal from near-chance embeddings; and (3) circuit attribution showing adversarial tasks engage attention circuits more than semantic tasks (p = 0.022; Jailbreak patching p < 0.001), with partial cross-model replication. Code release upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了当前LLM的OOD检测方法（如CED、RAUQ、WildGuard）存在序列长度混淆问题，并提出了一种两通路框架：嵌入通路处理主题偏移OOD，处理轨迹通路检测隐含意图OOD（如越狱攻击），并在多个任务上验证了框架的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有白盒OOD检测方法虽然看似有效，但实际上与序列长度存在高度相关性（|r| >= 0.61），在长度匹配评估下性能退化至接近随机水平。因此需要识别真正的OOD信号，消除长度伪影的干扰。
AI.method: 提出两通路框架：1）嵌入通路（embedding path）捕捉文本内容特征，适用于词汇区分性明显的OOD；2）处理轨迹通路（trajectory path）捕捉隐藏状态在层间的演化过程，适用于词汇与正常文本相似但意图隐蔽的OOD（如越狱攻击）。此外通过电路归因分析验证处理轨迹的有效性。
AI.result: 轨迹通路在隐蔽意图OOD检测上达到0.721平均AUROC（越狱检测0.850）；层0的k-NN信号几乎完全是长度伪影（越狱从0.759降至0.389）；对抗任务比语义任务更显著地激活注意力电路（p=0.022，越狱patching p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 两通路框架有效区分了不同类型的OOD信号，揭示了长度混淆问题，并验证了处理轨迹在检测隐蔽意图输入中的关键作用。不同OOD类型需要不同的检测通路，不存在通用最优方法。

title: Are You the A-hole? A Fair, Multi-Perspective Ethical Reasoning Framework
summary: Standard methods for aggregating natural language judgments, such as majority voting, often fail to produce logically consistent results when applied to high-conflict domains, treating differing opinions as noise. We propose a neuro-symbolic aggregation framework that formalizes conflict resolution through Weighted Maximum Satisfiability (MaxSAT). Our pipeline utilizes a language model to map unstructured natural language explanations into interpretable logical predicates and confidence weights. These components are then encoded as soft constraints within the Z3 solver, transforming the aggregation problem into an optimization task that seeks the maximum consistency across conflicting testimony. Using the Reddit r/AmItheAsshole forum as a case study in large-scale moral disagreement, our system generates logically coherent verdicts that diverge from popularity-based labels 62% of the time, corroborated by an 86% agreement rate with independent human evaluators. This study demonstrates the efficacy of coupling neural semantic extraction with formal solvers to enforce logical soundness and explainability in the aggregation of noisy human reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种神经符号聚合框架，利用加权最大可满足性（MaxSAT）和语言模型将自然语言解释转化为逻辑约束，通过Z3求解器实现冲突意见的优化聚合，在道德争议数据集上生成的逻辑一致裁决与人类评估者一致性达86%。
AI.motivation: 传统多数投票等聚合方法在处理高冲突领域时往往将观点分歧视为噪声，无法产生逻辑一致的结果，因此需要一种能处理冲突并保证逻辑一致性的聚合方法。
AI.method: 使用语言模型将非结构化自然语言解释映射为可解释的逻辑谓词和置信权重，将这些成分编码为Z3求解器中的软约束（基于加权MaxSAT），将聚合问题转化为追求冲突证词间最大一致性的优化任务。
AI.result: 在Reddit的r/AmItheAsshole数据集上，系统生成的逻辑一致裁决与基于流行度的标签在62%的情况下存在分歧，与独立人类评估者的一致性达到86%。
AI.conclusion: 将神经语义提取与形式求解器相结合，能够有效保证嘈杂人类推理聚合过程中的逻辑可解释性和逻辑健全性。

title: When Do Diffusion Models learn to Generate Multiple Objects?
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models achieve impressive visual fidelity, yet they remain unreliable in multi-object generation. Despite extensive empirical evidence of these failures, the underlying causes remain unclear. We begin by asking how much of this limitation arises from the data itself. To disentangle data effects, we consider two regimes across different dataset sizes: (1) concept generalization, where each individual concept is observed during training under potentially imbalanced data distributions, and (2) compositional generalization, where specific combinations of concepts are systematically held out. To study these regimes, we introduce mosaic (Multi-Object Spatial relations, AttrIbution, Counting), a controlled framework for dataset generation. By training diffusion models on mosaic, we find that scene complexity plays a dominant role rather than concept imbalance, and that counting is uniquely difficult to learn in low-data regimes. Moreover, compositional generalization collapses as more concept combinations are held out during training. These findings highlight fundamental limitations of diffusion models and motivate stronger inductive biases and data design for robust multi-object compositional generation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了文本到图像扩散模型在多目标生成中失败的根本原因，通过构建受控数据集MOSAIC发现：场景复杂度是主要影响因素而非概念不平衡；计数在低数据场景下特别难学；组合泛化在更多概念组合被排除时崩溃。
AI.motivation: 尽管扩散模型在视觉保真度上表现出色，但在多目标生成中仍不可靠。现有大量经验证据表明存在这些失败，但其根本原因尚不明确。本文旨在探究这一限制有多少来自数据本身。
AI.method: 引入受控数据集生成框架MOSAIC（多目标空间关系、属性归因、计数），通过在不同数据集规模下区分概念泛化和组合泛化两个场景，训练扩散模型并进行系统性分析。
AI.result: 场景复杂度是主导因素而非概念不平衡；计数在低数据场景下特别难以学习；组合泛化随着更多概念组合被排除而崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现揭示了扩散模型的基本局限性，并激励引入更强的归纳偏置和数据设计策略，以实现稳健的多目标组合生成。

title: AEM: Adaptive Entropy Modulation for Multi-Turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has significantly advanced the ability of large language model (LLM) agents to interact with environments and solve multi-turn tasks. Yet effective training remains challenging, as sparse, outcome-only rewards make it difficult to assign credit to individual steps in an agent's action trajectory. A common remedy is to introduce dense intermediate supervision, such as process reward models or auxiliary self-supervised signals, but this increases supervision and tuning complexity and often generalizes poorly across tasks and domains. This paper presents AEM, a supervision-free credit assignment method that adaptively modulates entropy dynamics during RL training to achieve a more effective exploration-exploitation trade-off. Theoretically, we elevate entropy analysis from the token level to the response level to reduce token sampling variance and show that entropy drift under natural gradients is intrinsically governed by the product of the advantage and the relative response surprisal. Specifically, we derive a practical proxy to reshape training dynamics, enabling a natural transition from exploration to exploitation. Extensive experiments across various benchmarks and models ranging from 1.5B to 32B parameters demonstrate the effectiveness of AEM, including a notable 1.4 percent gain when integrated into a state-of-the-art baseline on the highly challenging SWE-bench-Verified benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AEM，一种无需额外监督的信用分配方法，通过自适应调节熵动力学来优化RL训练中的探索-利用平衡，在多个基准和模型上取得显著效果。
AI.motivation: 现有RL训练LLM智能体时面临稀疏奖励带来的信用分配困难，而引入密集中间监督（如过程奖励模型）会增加监督和调优复杂度，且跨任务泛化能力差。
AI.method: 将熵分析从token级提升到response级以降低采样方差，理论上证明自然梯度下熵漂移由优势函数与相对响应惊奇度的乘积控制，并推导出实用代理来重塑训练动力学，实现从探索到利用的自然过渡。
AI.result: 在1.5B至32B参数的多模型和基准上验证有效性，在SWE-bench-Verified上集成到SOTA基线后取得1.4%的提升。
AI.conclusion: AEM是一种有效的免监督信用分配方法，可提升多步推理任务中RL训练的性能和泛化能力。

title: Thinking in Text and Images: Interleaved Vision--Language Reasoning Traces for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon robotic manipulation requires plans that are both logically coherent and geometrically grounded. Existing Vision-Language-Action policies usually hide planning in latent states or expose only one modality: text-only chain-of-thought encodes causal order but misses spatial constraints, while visual prediction provides geometric cues but often remains local and semantically underconstrained. We introduce Interleaved Vision--Language Reasoning (IVLR), a policy framework built around \trace{}, an explicit intermediate representation that alternates textual subgoals with visual keyframes over the full task horizon. At test time, a single native multimodal transformer self-generates this global semantic-geometric trace from the initial observation and instruction, caches it, and conditions a closed-loop action decoder on the trace, original instruction, and current observation. Because standard robot datasets lack such traces, we construct pseudo-supervision by temporally segmenting demonstrations and captioning each stage with a vision-language model. Across simulated benchmarks for long-horizon manipulation and visual distribution shift, \method{} reaches 95.5\% average success on LIBERO, including 92.4\% on LIBERO-Long, and 59.4\% overall success on SimplerEnv-WidowX. Ablations show that both modalities are necessary: without traces, LIBERO-Long success drops to 37.7\%; text-only and vision-only traces reach 62.0\% and 68.4\%, while the full interleaved trace reaches 92.4\%. Stress tests with execution perturbations and masked trace content show moderate degradation, suggesting that the trace can tolerate local corruption and moderate execution drift, but remains limited under stale or incorrect global plans.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IVLR策略框架，通过交错的文本子目标与视觉关键帧作为显式中间表征，实现长期机器人操作任务中逻辑与几何约束的统一，在LIBERO等基准上达到95.5%的平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作策略中，规划过程要么隐藏在隐状态中，要么仅暴露单一模态（纯文本链式推理缺乏空间约束，视觉预测缺乏语义约束），无法同时满足长期操作任务对逻辑连贯性和几何精确性的需求。
AI.method: 提出IVLR框架，构建Trace（交错的文本子目标与视觉关键帧）作为全局语义-几何中间表征；使用原生多模态Transformer在测试时自生成并缓存该表征，再将其与指令和当前观测共同输入闭环动作解码器；通过时间分割演示并用VLM标注每个阶段来构造伪监督数据。
AI.result: LIBERO平均成功率95.5%（LIBERO-Long 92.4%），SimplerEnv-WidowX总体成功率59.4%；消融实验显示无trace降至37.7%，纯文本trace 62.0%，纯视觉trace 68.4%，交错trace达92.4%；压力测试显示对局部扰动和漂移有一定鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 交错的视觉-语言trace是长期操作任务中有效且必要的中间表征形式，能同时编码因果顺序与空间约束；在全局规划过时或错误时仍存在局限性。

title: Structure-Aware Chunking for Tabular Data in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: 5 Pages, 1 figure, 4 Tables, 1 Algorithm, Work In Progress
summary: Tabular documents such as CSV and Excel files are widely used in enterprise data pipelines, yet existing chunking strategies for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) are primarily designed for unstructured text and do not account for tabular structure. We propose a structure-aware tabular chunking (STC) framework that operates on row-level units by constructing a hierarchical Row Tree representation, where each row is encoded as a key-value block. STC performs token-constrained splitting aligned with structural boundaries and applies overlap-free greedy merging to produce dense, non-overlapping chunks. This design preserves semantic relationships between fields within a row while improving token utilization and reducing fragmentation. Across evaluations on the MAUD dataset, STC reduces chunk count by up to 40% and 56% compared to standard recursive and key-value based baselines, respectively, while improving token utilization and processing efficiency. In retrieval benchmarks, STC improves MRR from 0.3576 to 0.5945 in a hybrid setting and increases Recall@1 from 0.366 to 0.754 in BM25-only retrieval. These results demonstrate that preserving structure during chunking improves retrieval performance, highlighting the importance of structure-aware chunking for RAG over tabular data.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向表格文档的结构感知分块框架（STC），基于行级单元构建层次化行树表示，通过约束分割和无重叠贪婪合并生成密集块，在MAUD数据集上分块数量减少40%-56%，检索指标MRR从0.3576提升至0.5945，Recall@1从0.366提升至0.754。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG分块策略主要面向非结构化文本，无法有效处理CSV、Excel等表格文档的结构信息，导致语义关系破坏和检索性能下降。
AI.method: 构建层次化行树（Row Tree）表示，将每行编码为键值对块；执行基于Token约束的结构边界分割；采用无重叠贪婪合并生成稠密、不重叠的块。
AI.result: 在MAUD数据集上，STC相比递归分块和键值对基线分块数量分别减少40%和56%；混合检索MRR从0.3576提升至0.5945；BM25检索Recall@1从0.366提升至0.754。
AI.conclusion: 保留表格结构进行分块能显著提升检索性能，结构感知分块对表格数据的RAG至关重要。

title: Efficient Spatio-Temporal Vegetation Pixel Classification with Vision Transformers
summary: Plant phenology-the study of recurrent life cycle events-is essential for understanding ecosystem dynamics and their responses to climate change impacts. While Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) and near-surface cameras enable high-resolution monitoring, identifying plant species across time remains computationally challenging. State-of-the-art approaches, specifically Multi-Temporal Convolutional Networks (CNNs), rely on rigid multi-branch architectures that scale poorly with longer time series and require large spatial context windows. In this paper, we present an extensive study on optimizing Vision Transformers (ViTs) for efficient spatio-temporal vegetation pixel classification. We conducted a comprehensive ablation study analyzing seven key design dimensions, including: (i) data normalization; (ii) spectral arrangement; (iii) boundary handling; (iv) spatial context window shape and size; (v) tokenization strategies; (vi) positional encoding; and (vii) feature aggregation strategies. Our method was evaluated on two datasets from the Brazilian Cerrado biome, Serra do Cipó (aerial imagery) and Itirapina (near-surface imagery). Experimental results demonstrate that our ViT approach offers a substantial improvement in computational efficiency while maintaining competitive classification performance. Notably, our ViT reduces Floating Point Operations (FLOPs) by an order of magnitude and maintains constant parameter complexity regardless of the time series length, whereas the CNN baseline scales linearly. Our findings confirm that ViTs are a robust, scalable solution for resource-constrained phenological monitoring systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了Vision Transformer（ViT）在植被物候像素分类中的应用，通过七项关键设计维度的消融实验，证明了ViT相比多时相CNN在保持竞争性能的同时，计算效率提升一个数量级，且参数量不随时间序列长度增加而增长。
AI.motivation: 现有基于多时相CNN的物候监测方法存在两个主要问题：多分支架构难以扩展至长时间序列，且需要较大的空间上下文窗口，导致计算效率低下。因此，需要探索更高效的时空植被分类方法。
AI.method: 对Vision Transformer在时空植被像素分类中的七个关键设计维度进行了全面的消融研究：数据归一化、光谱排列、边界处理、空间上下文窗口形状与大小、令牌化策略、位置编码、特征聚合策略。在巴西塞拉多生物群落的两个数据集（Serra do Cipó航空影像和Itirapina近地表影像）上进行评估。
AI.result: ViT方法在保持竞争性分类性能的同时，计算量（FLOPs）降低了一个数量级，且参数复杂度不受时间序列长度影响（保持恒定），而CNN基线模型的参数复杂度随序列长度呈线性增长。
AI.conclusion: Vision Transformer是一种稳健、可扩展的解决方案，适用于资源受限的物候监测系统。

title: On the Role of Artificial Intelligence in Human-Machine Symbiosis
summary: The evolution of artificial intelligence (AI) has rendered the boundary between humanity and computational machinery increasingly ambiguous. In the presence of more interwoven relationships within human-machine symbiosis, the very notion of AI-generated information becomes difficult to define, as such information arises not from either humans or machines in isolation, but from their mutual shaping. Therefore, a more pertinent question lies not merely in whether AI has participated, but in how it has participated. In general, the role assumed by AI is often specified, either implicitly or explicitly, in the input prompt, yet becomes less apparent or altogether unobservable when the generated content alone is available. Once detached from the dialogue context, the functional role may no longer be traceable. This study considers the problem of tracing the functional role played by AI in natural language generation. A methodology is proposed to infer the latent role specified by the prompt, embed this role into the content during the probabilistic generation process and subsequently recover the nature of AI participation from the resulting text. Experimentation is conducted under a representative scenario in which AI acts either as an assistive agent that edits human-written content or as a creative agent that generates new content from a brief concept. The experimental results support the validity of the proposed methodology in terms of discrimination between roles, robustness against perturbations and preservation of linguistic quality. We envision that this study may contribute to future research on the ethics of AI with regard to whether AI has been used fairly, transparently and appropriately.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种方法，用于追踪AI在自然语言生成中扮演的功能角色（辅助编辑 vs. 创意生成），通过将提示中隐含的角色信息嵌入生成内容中，并能够从生成文本中恢复该角色，实验验证了该方法在角色区分、鲁棒性和语言质量方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 随着AI与人类关系日益交织，AI生成信息的边界变得模糊，仅凭生成内容难以追溯AI的参与角色，因此需要一种方法从文本中推断AI所扮演的功能角色。
AI.method: 提出一种推断提示中隐含角色、将角色嵌入概率生成过程、并在生成文本中恢复AI参与性质的方法论。
AI.result: 在AI作为辅助编辑代理与创意生成代理两种场景下，实验支持该方法在角色区分、扰动鲁棒性和语言质量保持方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究可促进AI伦理领域关于公平、透明和适当使用AI的未来研究。

title: Prompt-Induced Score Variance in Zero-Shot Binary Vision-Language Safety Classification
summary: Single-prompt first-token probabilities from zero-shot vision-language model (VLM) safety classifiers are treated as decision scores, but we show they are unreliable under semantically equivalent prompt reformulation: even when the binary label is constrained to a fixed output position, equivalent prompts can induce materially different unsafe probabilities for the same sample. Across multimodal safety benchmarks and multiple VLM families, cross-prompt variance is strongly associated with prompt-level disagreement and higher error, making it a useful fragility diagnostic. A training-free mean ensemble improves NLL on all 14 dataset-model evaluation pairs and ECE on 12/14 relative to a train-selected single-prompt baseline, and wins more head-to-head NLL comparisons than labeled temperature scaling, Platt scaling, and isotonic regression applied to the same prompt. Ranking gains are consistent against the train-selected baseline on both AUROC and AUPRC, and against the full 15-prompt distribution remain consistent on AUPRC while softening on AUROC. Labeled calibration on top of the mean provides further gains when labels are available, identifying prompt averaging as a strong label-free first stage rather than a replacement for calibration. We frame this as a reliability stress test for zero-shot VLM first-token safety scores and recommend prompt-family evaluation with mean aggregation as a standard label-free reliability baseline.

AI.tldr: 零样本VLM安全分类器在语义等价提示下概率不可靠，提示平均集成无需训练即可提升性能，建议作为无标签可靠性基线。
AI.motivation: 揭示零样本VLM安全分类器在语义等价提示重组下首标记概率不可靠的问题，并寻求一种无需训练即可提升鲁棒性的方法。
AI.method: 分析跨提示方差与错误率关联；提出免训练的均值集成（prompt averaging），与温度缩放、Platt缩放、等渗回归等校准方法进行对比。
AI.result: 均值集成在14个数据集-模型组合上NLL全部提升，ECE在12/14上提升；在AUROC和AUPRC上一致优于单提示基线；在有标签时结合校准可进一步改进。
AI.conclusion: 提示均值集成是一种强大的无标签可靠性基线，可作为零样本VLM安全评分的标准预处理步骤，而非校准的替代品。

title: Beyond Visual Fidelity: Benchmarking Super-Resolution Models for Large-Scale Remote Sensing Imagery via Downstream Task Integration
summary: Super-resolution (SR) techniques have made major advances in reconstructing high-resolution images from low-resolution inputs. The increased resolution provides visual enhancement and utility for monitoring tasks. In particular, SR has been increasingly developed for satellite-based Earth observation, with applications in urban planning, agriculture, ecology, and disaster response. However, existing SR studies and benchmarks typically use fidelity metrics such as PSNR or SSIM, whereas the true utility of super-resolved images lies in supporting downstream tasks such as land cover classification, biomass estimation, and change detection. To bridge this gap, we introduce GeoSR-Bench, a downstream task-integrated SR benchmark dataset to evaluate SR models beyond fidelity metrics. GeoSR-Bench comprises spatially co-located, temporally aligned, and quality-controlled image pairs from about 36,000 locations across diverse land covers, spanning resolutions from 500m to 0.6m. To the best of our knowledge, GeoSR-Bench is the first SR benchmark that directly connects improved image resolution from SR models with downstream Earth monitoring tasks, including land cover segmentation, infrastructure mapping, and biophysical variable estimation. Using GeoSR-Bench, we benchmark GAN, transformer, neural operator, and diffusion-based SR models on perceptual quality and downstream task performance. We conduct experiments with 270 settings, covering 2 cross-platform SR tasks, 9 SR models, 3 downstream task models, and 5 downstream tasks for each SR task. The results show that improvements in traditional SR metrics often do not correlate with gains in task performance, and the correlations can be negative, indicating that these metrics provide limited guidance for selecting superior models for downstream tasks. This reveals the need to integrate downstream tasks into SR model development and evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoSR-Bench基准数据集，用于评估超分辨率模型在下游地球观测任务中的表现，发现传统SR指标（如PSNR/SSIM）与任务性能提升之间缺乏正相关性，甚至存在负相关。
AI.motivation: 现有超分辨率研究仅使用PSNR、SSIM等保真度指标评估模型，但这些指标无法反映超分图像在土地覆盖分类、生物量估算、变化检测等下游地球观测任务中的实际效用，存在评估与真实应用之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 构建GeoSR-Bench数据集，包含约36,000个空间共位、时间对齐、质量受控的图像对，分辨率从500米到0.6米，覆盖多种土地类型。采用GAN、Transformer、神经算子、扩散模型等9种SR模型，在270种实验设置下进行2个跨平台SR任务、3个下游任务模型和5个下游任务的基准测试。
AI.result: 传统SR指标的提升与下游任务性能提升之间常不相关，甚至呈负相关，说明这些指标对选择适用于下游任务的SR模型指导有限。
AI.conclusion: 应将下游任务整合到SR模型的开发与评估中，而非仅依赖传统保真度指标。

title: Instance-Aware Parameter Configuration in Bilevel Late Acceptance Hill Climbing for the Electric Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem
comment: Accepted at IEEE Congress on Evolutionary Computation (CEC), 2026
summary: Algorithm performance in combinatorial optimization is highly sensitive to parameter settings, while a single globally tuned configuration often fails to exploit the heterogeneity of instances. This limitation is particularly evident in the Electric Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem, where instances differ in structure, demand patterns, and energy constraints. This paper investigates instance-aware parameter configuration for Bilevel Late Acceptance Hill Climbing, a state-of-the-art metaheuristic for the Electric Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem. An offline tuning procedure is used to obtain instance-specific parameter labels, which are then mapped from instance features via a regression model to enable parameter prediction for unseen instances prior to execution. Experimental results on the IEEE WCCI 2020 benchmark and its extensions show that the proposed approach achieves an average objective value reduction of $0.28\%$ across eight held-out test instances relative to a globally tuned configuration. This corresponds to a significant cost reduction in multimillion-dollar transportation operations.

AI.tldr: 本文针对电动容量车辆路径问题，提出了一种基于实例感知的参数配置方法，通过离线调优获取实例特定参数标签，并利用回归模型从实例特征映射参数，在测试集上相比全局调优平均降低0.28%的目标值。
AI.motivation: 组合优化中算法性能对参数设置高度敏感，单一全局配置无法利用实例的异质性，尤其是在电动容量车辆路径问题中，实例在结构、需求模式和能量约束上存在差异，传统全局调优方法效果有限。
AI.method: 采用离线调优获取实例特定的参数标签，然后通过回归模型从实例特征中映射参数，实现对未见实例在执行前的参数预测。
AI.result: 在IEEE WCCI 2020基准测试及其扩展测试集上，所提方法在八个保留测试实例上平均目标值降低0.28%，对应数百万美元运输运营中的显著成本降低。
AI.conclusion: 实例感知的参数配置方法优于全局统一调优，能够有效提升算法在异构实例上的性能，具有实际应用价值。

title: Online Self-Calibration Against Hallucination in Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) often suffer from hallucinations, generating descriptions that include visual details absent from the input image. Recent preference alignment methods typically rely on supervision distilled from stronger models such as GPT. However, this offline paradigm introduces a Supervision-Perception Mismatch: the student model is forced to align with fine-grained details beyond its perceptual capacity, learning to guess rather than to see. To obtain reliable self-supervision for online learning, we identify a Generative-Discriminative Gap within LVLMs, where models exhibit higher accuracy on discriminative verification than open-ended generation. Leveraging this capability, we propose \textbf{O}nline \textbf{S}elf-\textbf{CA}lib\textbf{R}ation (OSCAR), a framework that integrates Monte Carlo Tree Search with a Dual-Granularity Reward Mechanism to construct preference data and iteratively refines the model via Direct Preference Optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OSCAR achieves state-of-the-art performance on hallucination benchmarks while improving general multimodal capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出在线自校准框架OSCAR，利用LVLM自身的生成-判别能力差距，通过蒙特卡洛树搜索和双粒度奖励机制构建偏好数据，迭代优化模型以减少幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有偏好对齐方法依赖强模型(GPT)的离线监督，导致学生模型被迫对齐超出自身感知能力的细节，产生"监督-感知不匹配"问题。
AI.method: 提出OSCAR框架：(1)利用LVLM的生成-判别差距获取可靠自监督；(2)集成蒙特卡洛树搜索与双粒度奖励机制构建偏好数据；(3)通过直接偏好优化(DPO)迭代优化模型。
AI.result: 在幻觉基准测试上达到最先进性能，同时提升通用多模态能力。
AI.conclusion: OSCAR通过在线自校准有效缓解了LVLM的幻觉问题，验证了利用模型自身能力进行自我优化的可行性。

title: Learn where to Click from Yourself: On-Policy Self-Distillation for GUI Grounding
summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) grounding maps natural language instructions to the visual coordinates of target elements and serves as a core capability for autonomous GUI agents. Recent reinforcement learning methods (e.g., GRPO) have achieved strong performance, but they rely on expensive multiple rollouts and suffer from sparse signals on hard samples. These limitations make on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), which provides dense token-level supervision from a single rollout, a promising alternative. However, its applicability to GUI grounding remains unexplored. In this paper, we present GUI-SD, the first OPSD framework tailored for GUI grounding. First, it constructs a visually enriched privileged context for the teacher using a target bounding box and a Gaussian soft mask, providing informative guidance without leaking exact coordinates. Second, it employs entropy-guided distillation, which adaptively weights tokens based on digit significance and teacher confidence, concentrating optimization on the most impactful and reliable positions. Extensive experiments on six representative GUI grounding benchmarks show that GUI-SD consistently outperforms GRPO-based methods and naive OPSD in both accuracy and training efficiency. Code and training data are available at https://zhangyan-ucas.github.io/GUI-SD/.

AI.tldr: 提出首个针对GUI定位的OPSD框架GUI-SD，通过视觉增强特权上下文和熵引导蒸馏，在六个基准上超越GRPO方法，兼顾精度与训练效率。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法（如GRPO）在GUI定位中需要多次rollout且硬样本信号稀疏，而OPSD虽能提供密集token级监督但尚未应用于GUI定位领域。
AI.method: 1) 构建视觉增强特权上下文（目标边界框+高斯软掩码）为教师模型提供信息引导；2) 熵引导蒸馏机制，根据数字显著性和教师置信度自适应加权token，聚焦关键可靠位置。
AI.result: 在六个代表性GUI定位基准上，GUI-SD在准确度和训练效率上均一致优于GRPO方法和朴素OPSD。
AI.conclusion: GUI-SD首次将OPSD成功应用于GUI定位，证明了其在精度和效率上的双重优势，代码与数据已开源。

title: Making Every Verified Token Count: Adaptive Verification for MoE Speculative Decoding
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by verifying multiple draft candidates in parallel, but this advantage weakens for sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. As the draft tree grows, different branches activate different experts, expanding the union of activated experts and substantially increasing target-side verification cost. We propose EVICT, a training-free, hyperparameter-free, and lossless adaptive verification method for MoE speculative decoding. EVICT makes every verified token count by truncating the draft tree before target verification and retaining only the cost-effective prefix. It leverages fine-grained drafter signals to estimate candidate benefit, combines them with offline-profiled verification cost, and remains highly compatible with the high-performance graph-based serving framework SGLang. Extensive experiments on diverse MoE backbones and benchmarks show that EVICT achieves up to 2.35x speedup over autoregressive decoding and an average 1.21x speedup over the state-of-the-art baseline EAGLE-3, while significantly reducing unnecessary expert activations during verification.

AI.tldr: EVICT是一种针对稀疏MoE模型的无需训练、无需超参数、无损的自适应验证方法，通过截断草稿树并保留成本效益前缀，在保持高质量生成的同时显著加速推理，相比自回归解码实现最高2.35倍加速，相比SOTA基线EAGLE-3平均加速1.21倍。
AI.motivation: 针对稀疏MoE模型中树型推测解码随草稿树增长导致激活专家数量扩大、目标端验证成本剧增的问题，提出一种无需额外训练的自适应验证方法。
AI.method: 在目标验证前截断草稿树，仅保留成本效益最高的前缀；利用细粒度的草稿信号估计候选收益，结合离线分析得到的验证成本进行决策，与SGLang推理框架高度兼容。
AI.result: 在多种MoE骨干网络和基准测试上，相比自回归解码实现最高2.35倍加速，相比EAGLE-3平均加速1.21倍，并显著减少了验证过程中的不必要专家激活。
AI.conclusion: EVICT是一种训练免费、超参数免费、无损的自适应验证方法，有效解决了MoE模型中树型推测解码的验证成本膨胀问题，在多个场景下取得显著加速效果。

title: To Call or Not to Call: A Framework to Assess and Optimize LLM Tool Calling
summary: Agentic AI architectures augment LLMs with external tools, unlocking strong capabilities. However, tool use is not always beneficial; some calls may be redundant or even harmful. Effective tool use, therefore, hinges on a core LLM decision: whether to call or not call a tool, when performing a task. This decision is particularly challenging for web search tools, where the benefits of external information depend on the model's internal knowledge and its ability to integrate potentially noisy tool responses. We introduce a principled framework inspired by decision-making theory to evaluate web search tool-use decisions along three key factors: necessity, utility, and affordability. Our analysis combines two complementary lenses: a normative perspective that infers true need and utility from an optimal allocation of tool calls, and a descriptive perspective that infers the model's self-perceived need and utility from their observed behaviors. We find that models' perceived need and utility of tool calls are often misaligned with their true need and utility. Building on this framework, we train lightweight estimators of need and utility based on models' hidden states. Our estimators enable simple controllers that can improve decision quality and lead to stronger task performance than the self-perceived set up across three tasks and six models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于决策理论的框架，用于评估AI模型在使用网络搜索工具时的必要性、效用和可负担性，发现模型对工具调用的自我感知与实际需求存在偏差，并训练轻量级估计器来改进决策质量。
AI.motivation: 工具调用并非总是有益，尤其是网络搜索工具可能引入噪声信息。现有模型在判断何时调用工具时存在决策困难，需要更系统的评估框架来理解和改进这一决策过程。
AI.method: 提出基于决策理论的框架，从规范性（推断真实需求）和描述性（推断模型自我感知）两个视角分析工具调用决策，并基于模型隐藏状态训练轻量级估计器来评估必要性和效用。
AI.result: 模型对工具调用的自我感知与实际需求存在错位；使用轻量级控制器可以改善决策质量，在三个任务和六个模型上取得比自我感知设置更强的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统化的框架分析和轻量级估计器，可以有效提升AI模型在工具调用决策上的表现，实现更优的任务性能。

title: MemRouter: Memory-as-Embedding Routing for Long-Term Conversational Agents
summary: Long-term conversational agents must decide which turns to store in external memory, yet recent systems rely on autoregressive LLM generation at every turn to make that decision. We present MemRouter, a write-side memory router that decouples memory admission from the downstream answer backbone and replaces per-turn memory-management decoding with an embedding-based routing policy. MemRouter encodes each turn together with recent context, projects the resulting embeddings through a frozen LLM backbone, and predicts whether the turn should be stored using lightweight classification heads while training only 12M parameters. Under a controlled matched-harness comparison on LoCoMo, where the retrieval pipeline, answer prompts, and QA backbone (Qwen2.5-7B) are held identical, MemRouter outperforms an LLM-based memory manager on every question category (overall F1 52.0 vs 45.6, non-overlapping 95% CIs) while reducing memory-management p50 latency from 970ms to 58ms. Descriptive factorial averaging further shows that learned admission improves mean F1 by +10.3 over random storage, category-specific prompting adds +5.2 over a generic prompt, and retrieval contributes +0.7. These results suggest that write-side memory admission can be learned by a small supervised router, while answer generation remains a separate downstream component in long-horizon conversational QA.

AI.tldr: MemRouter是一个写端记忆路由器，通过轻量级分类头（仅训练1200万参数）将记忆准入决策与下游答案生成解耦，在LoCoMo基准上以58ms延迟实现F1 52.0，显著优于基于LLM的记忆管理器（970ms, F1 45.6）。
AI.motivation: 现有长程对话系统依赖自回归LLM在每一轮进行记忆管理，计算开销大且耦合度高，需要将记忆准入决策与答案生成解耦，实现高效、独立的记忆管理。
AI.method: 将每轮对话与近期上下文编码为嵌入，通过冻结的LLM骨干网络投影，使用可训练的轻量级分类头（12M参数）预测是否存储该轮次，实现写端记忆路由。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo基准上，MemRouter整体F1达52.0（vs 45.6），p50延迟从970ms降至58ms；学习型准入比随机存储提升F1 +10.3，类别提示比通用提示提升+5.2，检索贡献+0.7。
AI.conclusion: 写端记忆准入可以通过小型监督路由器学习，答案生成可作为独立的下游组件，两者解耦在长程对话QA中有效且高效。

title: Position: agentic AI orchestration should be Bayes-consistent
summary: LLMs excel at predictive tasks and complex reasoning tasks, but many high-value deployments rely on decisions under uncertainty, for example, which tool to call, which expert to consult, or how many resources to invest. While the usefulness and feasibility of Bayesian approaches remain unclear for LLM inference, this position paper argues that the control layer of an agentic AI system (that orchestrates LLMs and tools) is a clear case where Bayesian principles should shine. Bayesian decision theory provides a framework for agentic systems that can help to maintain beliefs over task-relevant latent quantities, to update these beliefs from observed agentic and human-AI interactions, and to choose actions. Making LLMs themselves explicitly Bayesian belief-updating engines remains computationally intensive and conceptually nontrivial as a general modeling target. In contrast, this paper argues that coherent decision-making requires Bayesian principles at the orchestration level of the agentic system, not necessarily the LLM agent parameters.
